title: POST /v1/telemetry/ui request
description: Anonymous UI health report of a web client (ADR-086 section 5, 03-api.md section 4.11): main-thread blocks over 200 ms per view type since the last report. View names follow enums/ui-views.json (a well-formed name the hub does not know is counted as `other`); the hub clamps the counters to the limits of that file. The body is at most 8 KiB.

views.description: view type -> counters (at most 64 view types)
views.$comment: keys: the pattern of a view type, at most 64 characters (checked by the hub; JSON Schema keyword propertyNames is not in the allowed subset)
